title: Backyard Barbecue Chicken
description: For this backyard barbecue chicken recipe, chicken breasts are grilled in foil packets with frozen corn, bell pepper, and barbecue sauce until tender.
ingredients: 2 sheets (12x18-inches each) Reynolds Wrap® Heavy Duty Aluminum Foil
4 (4 ounce) boneless, skinless chicken breast halves
1 (10 ounce) package frozen whole kernel corn

steps.text: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat (or preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (232 degrees C)).
Place 2 chicken breasts in center of each foil sheet. Spoon ¼ cup barbecue sauce over each breast; top each breast with ¼ each corn and bell pepper.
Bring up sides of 1 foil sheet; double fold the top and ends to seal the packet, leaving room for heat circulation inside. Repeat with remaining foil sheet to make 2 packets.

Cook on the preheated grill, covered, (or place packets on a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven) until an instant-read thermometer inserted into chicken centers reads 165 degrees F (74 degrees C), 18 to 22 minutes.
Open packets carefully, allowing steam to escape, by cutting along top fold with a sharp knife.
